title: Italian Version of the Green Work Climate Scale: Validation and Within-Organization Differences in an Agrifood Company
abstract: Abstract: This study validated the Italian version of the Green Work Climate (GWC) scale, which assesses employees’ perceptions of their organization’s and coworkers’ commitment to environmental sustainability, and examined whether these perceptions differ across organizational contexts. Data were collected from 323 employees working at three sites of an Italian agrifood company. Confirmatory factor analysis supported the original two-factor structure and provided evidence of satisfactory reliability, convergent validity, and discriminant validity. Green Work Climate perceptions differed across organizational contexts, with office employees reporting higher levels than production workers and significant differences emerging across company sites. These findings support the Italian version of the GWC scale as a reliable tool for assessing sustainability climate and identifying contextual differences within organizations.
